interaction: Chain capture, guided hoist, latch on the slide stops and disabled hold
basis: Recorded cassette angle, carriage draw, keeper gate and drum coil of the forward centre-of-gravity climb trial at the gross mass. The approach to the capture angle is commanded; the catch dog, clutch and stop-pin movements are drawn allocations.

control.condition: Catch disabled, so the carriage never latches on its stops

brackets.input: centre of gravity ahead of nominal
brackets.note: Floor clearance in the disabled hold: 10.9 mm at 50 mm and 8.4 mm at 60 mm against 10 mm. Rearward the climb passes to -120 mm, the furthest tried.
A 5 s ramp latches but leaves 6.9 mm of floor clearance; ramps of 4 s and shorter do not latch and the robot returns to the carpet.

timestep.note: Floor clearance 11.51 mm at the coarse step and 11.54 mm at the fine step forward; 80.54 and 80.54 mm rearward.

limits: Rigid chain links and hooks, ideal slide stop pins and pitch lock, two hoist lines sharing load equally. The centre of gravity is unmeasured. A pass needs both hooks captured, the carriage latched before power is cut, a bus at or above 8 V and 10 mm of floor clearance through the disabled hold.
